core_principles: Color is Function Only: 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action.
Asymmetry and Grid Structures: Expose the skeleton. Use visible grid lines and 1px borders to separate content instead of drop shadows.
Generous Spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical SaaS to create a premium, uncrowded feel.
High Definition Text: Radical weight contrast (Black vs Light) with tight tracking on headings.
forbidden: Generic SaaS Blue (unless explicitly required for Microsoft SSO branding)

grid_strategies.launchpad: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 auto-rows-fr

header.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5

cards.classes: bg-white border border-gray-200 transition-all duration-200 hover:border-accent-primary hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors font-medium rounded-md px-6 py-2.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors font-medium rounded-md px-6 py-2.5
buttons.accent: bg-[#0047FF] text-white hover:bg-[#003BD1] transition-colors font-medium rounded-md px-6 py-2.5

login_page.layout: Two-column split screen (50/50). Left side contains login logic vertically centered with generous padding. Right side features a full-bleed architectural image.

elements.title: H1 with tracking-tighter, left-aligned.
elements.subtitle: Text-secondary, left-aligned.
elements.sso_button: Secondary button style, full width, with Azure/Microsoft icon.
elements.divider: Thin 1px border with 'OR' in small overline text.
elements.form: Shadcn input fields with sharp borders. Primary button full width.

launchpad.layout: Header with user profile, followed by a wide container with the app grid.

app_card.layout: Flex column, p-6, 1px border. Icon on top left, Title and Description below.
app_card.icon: Container: w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 border border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-center text-primary
app_card.title: H4, mt-4
app_card.hover_state: Border changes to #0047FF, icon scales up slightly (scale-105).

admin_panel.tabs: Use horizontal navigation if sidebar is not preferred. 1px bottom border for inactive, #0A0A0A border-b-2 for active.
admin_panel.tables: Cardless style. Raw HTML table or Shadcn Table inside a rounded-md container with 1px border. No shadows. Alternating row colors (white and #F9F9FA).
admin_panel.actions: Top right of table sections. 'Add New' buttons use Primary or Accent button styles.

interactions.hover: All interactive elements MUST explicitly set text color and background on hover.

image_urls.description: Minimalist white architectural interior showcasing futuristic design. Used as the right-side full-bleed image on the login page.

instructions_to_main_agent: Run: yarn add lucide-react (if not already installed) for icons.
Add Cabinet Grotesk (Heading) and IBM Plex Sans (Body) via Google Fonts or standard imports in index.html.
Build the Login page as a pure HTML/Tailwind split layout. Do NOT use Shadcn Card for the main login container to avoid boxed looks. Let the form breathe on the white background.
For the App Launchpad, use the grid classes specified in spacing_layout.grid_strategies.
Admin tables must NOT have drop shadows. Use simple borders (border-gray-200).
Use data-testid on ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='app-card-[app_id]').
For App Icons in the Launchpad, if a specific image logo is not provided, fallback to a lucide-react icon (e.g., LayoutDashboard, Users, Shield) enclosed in a rounded square.
Do NOT use arbitrary rounded classes higher than 'rounded-md' for general UI (keep it crisp).
